source_abilities.name: Hyoton
source_abilities.description:
Deals ice damage with a potency of 350.
Additional Effect: Bind
Duration: 15s
Mudra Combination: Ten→Jin or Chi→Jin
Cancels auto-attack upon execution.
Triggers the cooldown of weaponskills, mudra, and Ninjutsu upon execution.

※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Ninjutsu changes to Hyoton when requirements for execution are met.

source_abilities.name: Black Knight's Tour
source_abilities.description:
Deals unaspected damage to all enemies in a straight line before you with a potency of 200 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies.
Additional Effect: Potency is increased to 400 when enemies are under the effect of Slow. The Slow effect is also removed.
Additional Effect: Bind
Duration: 20s
